description: This file contains helper functions for MAC configuration in a 3GPP LTE/NR implementation, including default configurations for SRB and DRB, and functions to derive configurations based on QoS flows.

methods.name: make_default_srb_mac_lc_config
methods.description: Creates a default MAC logical channel configuration for SRB based on the logical channel ID.

methods.name: make_default_drb_mac_lc_config
methods.description: Creates a default MAC logical channel configuration for a non-GBR DRB.

methods.name: get_pbr_ceil
methods.description: Calculates the prioritized bit rate ceiling based on input bitrate in bps.

methods.name: make_gbr_drb_mac_lc_config
methods.description: Creates a GBR-specific DRB MAC logical channel configuration based on GBR QoS flow info.

methods.name: make_non_gbr_drb_mac_lc_config
methods.description: Creates a non-GBR DRB MAC logical channel configuration with default PBR.
